主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announced on February 24, 2017, that Jennifer Tory will transition from Group Head Personal & Commercial Bank (P&CB) to Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), while Neil McLaughlin will move from Executive Vice-President, Business Financial Services, P&CB to Group Head P&CB. The changes will take effect on May 1, 2017. Dave McKay, President and CEO, highlighted Tory's experience and focus on customer service, emphasizing her role in overseeing cross-business initiatives. Tory has led the transformation of RBC's Canadian retail bank to a digitally-enabled relationship bank over the past three years. The bank's strategic realignment in Caribbean Banking aims to improve client service and long-term profitability.
